Carlo Collodi, The Adventures of Pinocchio.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/carlo-collodi/the-adventures-of-pinocchio

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Carlo Collodi, the author, died 1890 (Wikidata Q199588, P570 = 1890-10-26).

First publication of the text used: 1883 (SE colophon: 'Pinocchio was published in 1883 by Carlo Collodi.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (rights statement below).
- Country of origin (Italy): the text was first published there in 1883 (serial in the Giornale per i bambini, then as a book; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Adventures_of_Pinocchio, country: Italy). Copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die was Carlo Collodi, in 1890, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 1961.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

- Wikidata Q199588 (Carlo Collodi), P570 = 1890-10-26
